# act_email_integration (Data Source)

The Act-managed email integration. Every tenant has one; its `id` goes in the `email` block of notification rules and recipients.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "act_email_integration" "this" {}

output "email_integration_id" {
  value = data.act_email_integration.this.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) The name Act shows for the integration.
- `id` (String) The integration ID.
- `status` (String) The connection status, normally `connected`.
